artDirection.summary: Original colorful City Horizon key art: exaggerated perspective city, oversized Ferris wheel, curving road, water, layered trees, dramatic warm/cool lighting, clouds and hot-air balloons. It is poster-like loading art rather than a gameplay scene.
rules: do not obey gameplay grid, footprints or CH_CAMERA_V1
do not limit visible objects to current runtime assets
prefer exaggerated silhouette, depth and color over map accuracy
keep upper-left region usable for the City Horizon logo
keep the bottom loading-progress band free of irreplaceable focal detail
do not bake the game logo or loading text into the illustration
